title: Presales Engineer
summary: Presales engineers help sell software and cloud products by understanding a customer's needs and showing how the product meets them. They pair with account managers, running discovery calls, demos and proofs of concept (short trial setups), and write the technical parts of proposals.
dailyDuties: Set up and run proofs of concept
Write technical answers for RFPs and proposals
Draw solution designs and build ROI cases
Pass customer feedback to the product team

skills.expectation: Shape solutions and write technical answers for RFPs and proposals
Run tailored product demos and customer proofs of concept
Run discovery calls to learn the customer's needs and current setup
Present clearly to both technical and business buyers
Work with sales, product and the customer's team through the deal
Build ROI and value cases for the buyer
Explain and show how the product integrates with other systems
Know at least one major cloud well enough to design deployments
Know at least one major cloud well enough to design deployments
Know at least one major cloud well enough to design deployments

groups.label: A cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP)

certifications.why: Shows you can design on AWS, which most cloud deals need
Basic Azure knowledge for Microsoft-led deals
